newsitem.title: UK: Abbey in bid talks with Cater Allen.
newsitem.headline: Abbey in bid talks with Cater Allen.

text.p: Britain's Abbey National Plc said on Monday it was in talks with financial services group Cater Allen that may lead to it making an offer for Cater.
Earlier, Abbey had declined to comment on press reports linking it to a 200 million pounds ($326.8 million) bid for Cater which acts as a discount house and recently bought a stockbroking business.
Cater Allen shares surged about 25 percent on June 5, after it said it was in talks that could lead to an offer. On Monday, they stood 2.5p lower at 547.5p after the Abbey announcement.
Various groups have mentioned as bidders for Cater but Abbey is thought to want to add the company to its well developed Treasury division.
In particular, Cater has a successful investment operation based in Jersey, which would fit well with Abbey's existing operations.

Abbey, whose shares were down 25.5p at 870p in a lower banking sector, was recently linked to UK banking giant National Westminster Bank Plc and later confirmed that it had held discussions with NatWest, which had been terminated.
